notes.title: Level adjustments and Quality-of-life improvements
notes.content:
[p]Tentacle Troop, assemble!![/p][p]Get ready for a fresh update to the demo, packed with some awesome quality-of-life improvements and level adjustments. We've heard your feedback and made a bunch of tweaks to make your gameplay experience even smoother and more fun. [/p][p]Notably, in Level 5 no more risk of spawnkill at Checkpoint 2 (Entschuldigung HollaDieWaldfee und Maxim, but thank you for showing us that this is something that could happen). [/p][p]Level 6, Spikeridge Pathway, has been made a bit easier, and you'll find more cool decorations throughout all the levels.[/p][p]Dive in and check out all the details below![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246212/c7867e6448d5627915c1bfb74b548f6bff7c218d.png"][/img][/p][h3]
General[/h3][list][*][p]Added boulders to all levels. Boulders are non-hazardous obstacles, similar in size to the smaller palm trees.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p]Players are no longer locked out of jumping before reaching checkpoint 1 in the tutorial.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Level 1 - Instructional Beach[/h3][list][*][p]Added the Starbar, and a palm forest behind it, at the start of the level.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Level 2 - Around the Bend[/h3][list][*][p]Added more walls to bend around, especially in the later stages of the level.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the placement of checkpoint 3 to be closer to the path forward.[/p][/*][*][p]Made the path forward from checkpoint 3 more obvious.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Level 3 - Baaahdside Docks[/h3][list][*][p]The name has been changed to better fit the enemy models.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the starting segment to keep the focus on one aspect of the enemies at a time.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the ending segment to make it easier to wait for the first enemies to walk off the platform.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Level 4 - The Old Tropic Pathway[/h3][list][*][p]No changes except for boulders :)[/p][/*][/list][h3]Level 5 - Teeming Islands[/h3][list][*][p]Moved the first enemy closer to the wooden platform.[/p][/*][*][p]Widened the platform that checkpoint 2 is on to prevent a potential spawnkill from happening if you trigger the enemy and take the checkpoint before killing said enemy. (Entschuldigung HollaDieWaldfee und Maxim, but thank you for showing us that this is something that could happen)[/p][/*][*][p]Made the ending segment easier by removing some of the platform on the right side.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Level 6 - Spikeridge Pathway[/h3][list][*][p]The second segment is now the second-to-last segment instead to better fit the difficulty scaling of the level.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug which sometimes caused spike walls to [b]not[/b] kill the player.[/p][/*][*][p]The now second (previously third) segment had one of the brittle platforms replaced with a sturdy wooden platform.[/p][/*][*][p]The now fourth (previously second-to-last) segment has been made easier by widening some platforms, and making the blocking walls triangular to allow earlier arm extensions.[/p][/*][*][p]These changes have made the level overall slightly longer.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Level 7 - Longbend Bounce[/h3][list][*][p]Replaced almost half of the palm trees in the ending segment with water pools.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Level 8 - Dodge, Dip, and Dive[/h3][list][*][p]No changes except for boulders :)[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246212/67b0615b7174ef16ad8be8e6dcdb0873f96cecd4.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246212/aa6cae2203de951be3dc54154a5f4401a1abf1e2.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Tentacle Tango – A not so typical Swedish dance
notes.content: [p]We're happy to announce that [b]Tentacle Tango[/b] is part of the [b]Made In Sweden[/b] lineup this summer. While tango might not be a strong Swedish dance tradition, we think you'll notice the game's Swedish roots in some of its wild landscapes and environments.[/p][p]In this stream, you can follow designers Dan and Benji as they struggle to master the two intertwined octopuses.[/p][p]We're also getting closer to a definite release date and will share it with you soon![/p][p]In the meantime, enjoy the demo![/p][p]Cheers, Kristian[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
[h1]Demo Changes 12-20-24[/h1]
[h2]Summary[/h2]
[list]
[*]Leaderboards can now be viewed from the level select screen.
[*]Several QoL changes to gameplay and levels. (See details for more info)
[/list]
[h2]Details[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*]Leaderboards can now be viewed from the level select screen.
[*]Added a credits screen to the main menu.
[*]The death counter now displays numbers in the hundreds (and higher) correctly.
[*]The water no longer cuts off abruptly for users with ultrawide monitors.
[*]Added a jump animation to the player characters.
[*]Small changes in the text of the end-of-the-demo screen.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] [Co-op] Both players pressing the switch button immediately after each other will no longer swap the players twice, only once, as the players intended.
[*] The game now pauses everything except the starfish when a level is completed to reduce confusion.
[*] Jumping now locks spinning a little longer, making several jumps in short succession go in the same direction instead of curving a little with every jump.
[*] Jumps now have more height to them. (Length is still the same)
[*] Added a camera shake when the player dies.
[*] [Co-op] Lowered the arm stretching speed of each player.
[*] Bending around something and colliding with the other character will now switch who’s standing on the ground.
[*] The pink pearl’s hitbox is now slightly bigger.
[*] Bouncing at very low speeds no longer plays a sound effect.
[/list]

[h3]Level 1 - Instructional Beach[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed the wall beneath the starting area.
[*] Players can no longer jump until the jumping tutorial prompt has appeared.
[*] Updated the jumping tutorial prompt to include more information.
[*] Remade the jumping tutorial to include obligatory jumping tasks.
[*] Added an ‘L’ to the stretch arms tutorial prompt stick(s).
[*] Remade the stretch arms segment.
[/list]

[h3]Level 2 - Around the Bend[/h3]
[list]
[*] Moved the first checkpoint away from the nearby wall for greater visibility.
[*] Made the path forward after the third checkpoint easier to see by making the start and end wider.
[/list]

[h3]Level 3 - Moleside Docks[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated enemy models.
[*] Made almost every platform wider.
[*] Added an enemy that shows how falling platforms work.
[/list]

[h3]Level 4 - The Old Tropic Pathway[/h3]
[list]
[*] Made the wall next to the second checkpoint smaller to reduce the risk of bouncing off of it.
[/list]

[h3]Level 5 - Teeming Islands[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated enemy models.
[*] Added more decorations.
[*] Widened some of the wooden platforms at the start of the level.
[*] Widened the first wooden bridge after checkpoint 2.
[/list]

[h3]Level 6 - Spikeridge Pathway[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a safe place to stand before the first obstacle.
[*] Replaced some of the spiky wall on the right of the segment after checkpoint 1 with regular stone walls.
[*] Moved the spiky walls closer to the falling platforms in the segment after checkpoint 2.
[*] Cleaned up checkpoint 4 to make it easier to see where you’re supposed to go.
[*] Made the last segment easier by making the last wooden platform larger and removing the tip of the spiky wall.
[/list]

[h3]Level 7 - Longbend Bounce[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added more decorations throughout the level.
[*] Added wooden platforms between the islands in the starting area to act as guides.
[*] Added a smaller version of the first obstacle to lower confusion.
[*] Moved checkpoint 3 back a little.
[*] Added more to the spiky wall to the left of checkpoint 3.
[*] Added a safe place to stand to the right of the falling platforms right before checkpoint 4.
[*] Shortened the length of the segment after checkpoint 4.
[*] Increased the length of the segment after checkpoint 5.
[/list]

[h3]Level 8 - Dodge, Dip, and Dive[/h3]
[list]
[*] Made the first U-turn slightly longer.
[*] Moved some of the cannons to adjust for the U-turn being longer.
[*] Added a checkpoint right after the U-turn.
[*] Made the platform after the new checkpoint 1 wider.
[*] Added more to the platform surrounding the now second checkpoint.
[*] It is now more obvious that you can go around the stone wall next to the now third checkpoint as a safer option.
[*] Added some wooden bridges between some of the platforms after the now third checkpoint.
[*] Made the now checkpoint 4 platform wider.
[/list]

notes.title: Tentacle Tango in the Difficult Game Bash
notes.content:
The Difficult Game Bash is on! In the coming days you can to challenge yourself by playing the most difficult games on Steam. Tentacle Tango is one of them.

Don’t let the cute looks fool you—this game is designed to test your every move. In Tentacle Tango, you'll control a duo of daring characters connected by an unbreakable bond (literally). Twist, swing, and strategize your way through levels filled with tricky traps, ruthless enemies, and mind-bending puzzles. 

It takes two to tango in this deadly dance. Play solo, controlling both characters, or team up with a friend in local co-op mode. Whether you're flying solo or partnering up, success hinges on perfect synchronization and timing.

Think you can handle the toughest challenge of the year? Jump in and find out!
